revision_rule.note: IEEE 1800-2012 does not define the svGetTime DPI utility or its scope-based time-scaling behavior.
IEEE 1800-2017 does not define the svGetTime DPI utility or its scope-based time-scaling guarantee.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not define the DPI svTimeVal type or guarantee equivalence to VPI s_vpi_time.
IEEE 1800-2017 does not define svTimeVal or require equivalence with VPI s_vpi_time.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not define svGetTimeUnit or svGetTimePrecision DPI queries.
IEEE 1800-2017 does not define the svGetTimeUnit and svGetTimePrecision DPI queries.

IEEE 1800-2012 requires every VPI call from an imported subroutine to use the context qualifier; it does not provide the later exception list for model-independent I/O, MCD, and vpi_get_vlog_info routines.
